hints.title: Difference Array Modeling
hints.text: A person born in birth and dying in death contributes +1 from birth up to death - 1.

hints.title: Event Boundary Marking
hints.text: Increment the delta at index birth - 1950 and decrement the delta at index death - 1950.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Sweep
hints.text: Compute cumulative population across years from 1950 to 2050 to find the maximum value.

hints.title: Full Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def maximumPopulation(self, logs: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        diff = [0] * 101
        for b, d in logs:
            diff[b - 1950] += 1
            diff[d - 1950] -= 1

        max_pop = 0
        best_year = 1950
        curr_pop = 0

        for i in range(101):
            curr_pop += diff[i]
            if curr_pop > max_pop:
                max_pop = curr_pop
                best_year = 1950 + i

        return best_year
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Incrementing each year individually across wide ranges wastes repeated iterations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Difference array with prefix sum sweeps across 100 years in O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles exclusive death year by decrementing at death.
